description: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) solution of the Allen-Cahn equation (SciML-PINN).
user_request:
Now lets solve the Allen Cahn equation in particular:
u_t-epsilon u_xx+k(u^3-u)=0

u(x,0)=x^2cos(pi x)

The domain in x goes from -1 to 1 and in t from 0 to 1 with periodic boundary conditions in x. Here epsilon=0.0001 and k=5

### Reference Data: 
You can find the data here:
/oscar/data/gk/jdtoscan/References/ATHENA_Agentic_Team_for_Hierarchical_Evolutionary_Numerical_Algorithms/Documents/codes/Data/allen_cahn.mat

The solutions are saved as a dictionary with keys 't', 'x' and 'usol'.
